title: Quarterly flight-path: scenario lanes for Hosted API + Model Catalog prioritization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a bounded, scenario-driven quarterly roadmap (flight-path) that maps prioritized model-catalog lineup and Hosted API releases into three execution lanes: Fast-path (PLG-friendly, low-risk variants), Hedged-path (dedicated capacity + quantized variants for cost targets), and Resilience-path (fallbacks, cross-region redundancy). This ticket synthesizes OKR targets, capacity constraints, gating criteria, and cross-team dependencies into a single decision matrix and rollout deck for the Q2 planning cadence.
acceptance_criteria: A single decision matrix that ranks model candidates by customer impact, cost-per-token delta, and compatibility (quantized/FP16)
Clear rollout windows for each lane with canary criteria, rollback thresholds, and owner for each step
Estimated capacity/cost delta for top 3 scenarios with trade-off notes and a recommended primary lane
Stakeholder sign-off from Runtime, Infra, and Developer Experience leads
Confluence deck published and shared with GTM and Solutions before the quarterly kickoff
notes: This ticket is intentionally scoped to produce a single convergent recommendation for the leadership OKR review rather than a laundry list of possibilities.
We will maintain a separate appendix with alternate scenarios (aggressive-cost, conservative-slo, and regulatory-compliant) to avoid scope creep in the main decision matrix.
